title: Chrono24 Listing Ask Price Leaderboard
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chrono24:listing ask_price_usd=*
| stats sum(ask_price_usd) as total_value, avg(ask_price_usd) as avg_value by brand
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks brand values by total and average ask price across Chrono24 listing events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `ask_price_usd` values for each Chrono24 listing event and review total and average ask price by brand.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total ask price.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which brand shows the biggest ask price numbers in your Chrono24 listing data.
